title: Infinite $τ$-tilting theory
summary: We classify torsion pairs in an essentially small abelian category through cosilting subsets of the Ziegler spectrum of the ind-completion of the abelian category. For Artin algebras, this classification is reformulated as an infinite analog of $τ$-tilting theory, where torsion classes correspond to support $τ$-tilting subsets of the Ziegler spectrum and torsion-free classes correspond to support $τ^-$-tilting subsets.
